title: WhereWereYou
description: Track down players for a price. Pay diamonds to reveal where they were last seen.
body:
# WhereWereYou

WhereWereYou lets players look up the last known location of any player on the server — but it'll cost them.
Use `/wherewereyou <player>` or `/wwy <player>` to get started. You'll be shown a confirmation with the diamond cost before anything is taken. Accept to reveal their last seen time, world, and exact coordinates.

## Features:
- Escalating diamond cost per lookup (5 → 10 → 20)
- Max 3 lookups per player per day
- 1 minute cooldown between lookups
- Clickable Accept/Decline confirmation in chat
- All costs and limits configurable in config.yml

## Commands:
`/wherewereyou <player>` or `/wwy <player>`

## Compatibility:
Paper 26.1.2+
